tools.name: ipeds_search_programs
tools.description: Search the full CIP 2020 taxonomy (2,143 program codes) by keyword or partial code. Returns matching CIP codes + titles. The entry point: get a cip_code here, then use it with the institution/program tools.

keyword.description: Keyword or partial CIP code to search the CIP 2020 taxonomy, e.g. 'data science', 'nursing', '11.07'.

tools.name: ipeds_program_occupations
tools.description: Given a CIP program code, list the occupations (SOC codes + titles) it crosswalks to, from the official NCES CIP-to-SOC mapping. Use to bridge a degree program to the labor-market roles it feeds.

cip_code.description: CIP code, e.g. '11.0701' (Computer Science) or '52.02' (Business). Use ipeds_search_programs to find one.

tools.name: ipeds_get_institution
tools.description: Profile a higher-ed institution by name or IPEDS unit id: enrollment, tuition, admission rate, demographics, online-only flag, completion rate, and post-enrollment earnings.

unit_id.description: IPEDS Unit ID (6-digit), e.g. 104151 for ASU.

tools.name: ipeds_get_enrollment_trend
tools.description: Enrollment + student-body composition for one institution: size, 12-month grad headcount, part-time share, share 25+, race/ethnicity and gender breakdown, online-only flag.

unit_id.description: IPEDS Unit ID (6-digit), e.g. 104151 for ASU.

tools.name: ipeds_compare_programs
tools.description: Institutions offering a given CIP program at a degree level, ranked by enrollment size, with tuition, completion, and earnings. Use for market-saturation analysis: how many schools offer this program?

cip_code.description: CIP code, e.g. '11.0701' (Computer Science) or '52.02' (Business). Use ipeds_search_programs to find one.

degree_level.description: Degree level: certificate, associate, bachelors, masters, or doctorate.

tools.name: ipeds_find_competitors
tools.description: Largest institutions offering a CIP program (any level), optionally limited to online-only schools, ranked by enrollment. The core competitive-landscape tool.

cip_code.description: CIP code, e.g. '11.0701' (Computer Science) or '52.02' (Business). Use ipeds_search_programs to find one.
